package.description: 桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己干活，也能把专业的活派给编程助手。

en-US.description: A desktop AI companion that connects any model, does the work itself, and delegates specialist jobs to coding agents.
en-US.longDescription:
Nomi is an AI companion living on your desktop: bring any model, let it do the work, and let it hand specialist jobs to specialist AIs. Models, coding agents, MCP and local tools all connect in one place, coordinated by Nomi.
Connect a model once and every AI can use it: after adding a provider, Nomi itself plus Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok and dsh can use any of its models, or everything can switch to local models. The local gateway detects and translates between Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Responses, OpenAI Chat Completions and Gemini generateContent, so streaming, tool calls, reasoning, images and context compaction keep working.
Tasks can be limited to specific folders, coding assistants get a two-column workspace, and the desktop mascot shows speech and confirmation bubbles. The app runs on a Go core with the native WebView, installs per user without administrator rights, and needs the Edge WebView2 runtime, which is usually preinstalled on Windows 10 and 11.

zh-CN.description: 桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己干活，也能把专业的活派给编程助手。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Nomi 是住在你桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己动手干活，也会把专业的活派给专业的 AI。模型、编程助手、MCP 与本地工具都接到一处，由 Nomi 统一调度。
模型只接一次就能给所有 AI 使用：添加一次供应商，Nomi 自己和 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Grok、dsh 都能用它的任意模型，也可以全部换成本地模型。本机网关自动识别并互转 Anthropic Messages、OpenAI Responses、OpenAI Chat Completions 与 Gemini generateContent，流式、工具调用、推理、图片和上下文压缩都照常工作。
任务可以限定能访问的文件夹，编程助手有独立的两栏工作区，桌面角色会显示台词与确认气泡。应用为 Go 内核加原生 WebView，单个安装包约 39 MB，按当前用户安装，不需要管理员权限。
zh-CN.name: Nomi
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Nomi· 诺米 2.3.9
可以自己配主题了；文件在对话窗口里直接预览和编辑；每个会话可以选显示多详细。 / Make your own themes; preview and edit files right in the chat window; choose how much detail each chat shows.
新功能 / New
- 设置 → 外观新增「我的主题」：填强调色、背景、表面、文字 4 个颜色就能新建主题，其余颜色自动推导并修正对比度；浅色、深色可以各配一套跟随系统，能加背景图，也能导入导出主题包 / Settings → Appearance adds "My themes": pick accent, background, surface and text colors and the rest is derived with contrast fixes; set one for light and one for dark to follow the system, add a background image, and import or export theme packs
- 文件侧栏可以预览和编辑文档与源码，支持行号定位、目录和搜索；文件专注模式下对话收成右下角的 Nomi 按钮，选中文字可以直接「问助手」 / The file side panel previews and edits documents and source code, with line jumps, an outline and search; in file focus mode the chat folds into a Nomi button at the bottom right, and selected text can be sent with "Ask"
- 会话详细程度：设置里选全局默认（精简 / 显示思考 / 详细），每个会话还可以在标题栏单独选；精简时同类工具调用合成一行（#310） / Transcript detail: pick a default in Settings (compact / show thinking / detailed) and override it per chat from the title bar; compact folds tool calls of the same kind into one line (#310)
- Agent 看板可以暂停 / 继续 Nomi 的后台运行：正在跑的这一轮跑完后停下，直到手动继续 / The agent board can pause and resume Nomi's background runs: the current turn finishes, then it waits until you resume it
- 编程助手登录被 403 拒绝时给出原因，可以一键沿用终端里的代理重试；从 Finder / Dock 启动时也会用上终端配置的代理 / When a coding agent's sign-in is rejected with 403, Nomi explains why and can retry with your terminal's proxy; launching from Finder or the Dock now picks up that proxy too
- 新版本下载好后，「重启更新」按钮显示在标题栏右侧；检查更新改为每 3 小时一次 / Once an update is downloaded, the "Restart to update" button sits at the right of the title bar; updates are checked every 3 hours
- 菜单、会话详情和右栏展开收起有过渡动画（开了「减少动态效果」时不播放） / Menus, session details and the side panel animate in and out (not when Reduce Motion is on)
修复 / Fixes
- 运行中改了项目的文件夹，这一轮结束后按新的文件夹同步，下一轮就在新目录里工作（#309） / Changing a project's folders while a coding agent is running now syncs after the turn, so the next turn uses the new folders (#309)
- 分叉没有项目的会话时，副本不再被归进当前打开的对话的项目（#308） / Forking a chat without a project no longer puts the copy into the project of the chat you have open (#308)
- 关掉标签再从历史打开同一个编程助手会话，单独选的详细程度还在（#313） / A coding session's own transcript detail is kept after closing the tab and reopening it from history (#313)
- Agent 看板：终端里开的会话做完后不再一直显示「现在有动静」，会按时收起；关掉「内存紧张时自动处理」不再提前恢复 Nomi 暂停的标签（#316）；一直用同一个会话的标签重启后不再被当成终端会话（#315） / Agent board: finished terminal sessions no longer always show "active just now" and hide on time; turning off automatic handling no longer resumes tabs Nomi paused (#316); a tab that kept one session is no longer shown as a terminal session after a restart (#315)
- 沙箱里的编程助手可以读 ~/.npmrc（npm 镜像源能用，nvm 不再报错），写入仍然拦截；技能脚本没有执行权限时改用解释器运行，不再误以为被沙箱拦下 / Coding agents in the sandbox can read ~/.npmrc (npm mirrors work and nvm stops erroring) but still can't write it; skill scripts without execute permission are run through their interpreter instead of being mistaken for a sandbox block
- macOS 上桌面角色不在前台时按住就能拖，不用先点一下；角色窗口从隐藏恢复时静态形象不再空白 / On macOS the desktop character can be dragged right away when it isn't in front; the static character no longer shows up blank when its window is shown again
- 文件预览遵守受保护文件夹设置；「…」和「更多」按钮再点一次就关掉菜单 / File previews respect protected folders; clicking "…" or "More" again closes the menu
变化 / Changes
- 更快更省：Agent 看板与进度监控共用进程列表，macOS 与 Windows 上读进程表不再起子进程，没有编程助手在跑时更少轮询；长会话和流式输出时少做很多重复计算 / Faster and lighter: the agent board and progress monitor share one process list, reading it no longer spawns a subprocess on macOS and Windows, idle polling is rarer, and long chats and streaming redo far less work
